_comment: receipt (src/receipt): code checks of what a paid purchase returned. mode record writes a delivery_review event per paid task purchase (hash, size, fields_ok; never the body). history: over the latest `window` checks of the same target, `poor_at` empty ones -> ASK_HUMAN DELIVERY_HISTORY_POOR, `mismatch_at` with fields_ok false -> ASK_HUMAN DELIVERY_HISTORY_MISMATCH. Values as in x402-Interlock config/appe-thresholds.json delivery_review.
